_what_this_is: the maintainer decision permitting ONE Phase-C1 session -- attempt 10, the FIRST of the three the 2026-09-11 execution package allows. An INPUT to the issuer, which derives every identity from the committed objects and REFUSES a grant that asserts one. It states only what a maintainer owns: who permitted what, at what cumulative spend, against which cap, and what it does not cover.
_where_this_lives: inside its own run, at logs/runs/phase_c1/attempt10/governance/grant.json, because a grant is a fact about one attempt and needs an owner. The nine predecessors were flat files in the log root. `open_run` admits this path by name as a declared prepared input; `grant_provenance_gate` then refuses unless the authorization's recorded reference resolves to THIS file and still hashes to the value it was issued from.

granted_by: maintainer decision, 2026-09-11, recorded after an independent engineering review of the increment 55bb324a..199711af found the prepared-grant / run-opening seam and the grant-provenance repair sound and reported no new material blocker. covers: exactly one C1 launch under the UNCHANGED frozen C1 protocol at a hard ceiling of $15.1475: the frozen fixed-path ATTENTION isolation, 2 frozen arms x 3 frozen fresh paired seeds = exactly six E1_KD_HEAVY_0860K recovery trainings; ALL SIX trainings complete before any confirmation evaluation begins; exactly one frozen confirmation evaluation per completed probe, each admitted against its own observed generation protocol before scoring; followed by the existing frozen GO / NO-GO / INCONCLUSIVE decision rule. Nothing in the protocol, the arms, the seeds, the battery, the recovery recipe, the generation protocol, the scoring contract, the statistic or the behavioural vetoes may move.

one_use.consumed_when: THE FORMAL LAUNCHER IS INVOKED under the authorization issued from this grant -- even if it then refuses at $0 before any provider resource exists. This is the 2026-09-11 package rule and it is PROSPECTIVE: it governs this package's attempts and does not rewrite the 2026-09-04 ruling, under which attempt 3 was not consumed because no provider resource was created. That record stands verbatim as the rule attempt 3 ran under.
one_use.no_hidden_retries: one provider-create call and one resource for this invocation. A replacement pod, an internal redraw, a fresh run_id or a re-issuance does not evade the package's count of three.
one_use.after_consumption: this grant is spent. A further attempt needs a NEW grant, a NEW launch-bound readiness record, a NEW one-use authorization and a NEW bundle, and is permitted only while the package's six retry conditions all hold.

package.limits_do_not_transfer: the engineering allowance, the per-attempt ceiling, the attempt count, the package total and the project cap bind separately. A cheap failure does not buy a fourth attempt; an unspent engineering allowance does not raise this ceiling.
autonomous_retry_requires_all_of: it can be CONFIRMED that no formal probe training has started
the failure is an ordinary infrastructure failure whose cause is identified and addressed
frozen science, the input contracts and the decision rule are unchanged
the previous resource is confirmed no longer billing
the remaining count and balance still fund a COMPLETE attempt plus teardown
the new attempt uses a new run identity and a complete, valid one-use authorization chain
stop_and_report: the first probe has STARTED training, finished or not
it cannot be confirmed whether training started -- absence of confirmation is not confirmation of absence
a real replay mismatch at stage D or E
an input-identity conflict that cannot be restored to its frozen binding
anything requiring a change to the scientific protocol
any complete valid GO / NO-GO / INCONCLUSIVE -- all three end the package's formal attempts
a package, count, ceiling or cap boundary is reached, or a resource's billing state is unknown

pre_provider_refusal: a pre-provider gate refusal costs $0.00 and creates nothing, but under this package it still CONSUMES this attempt, because the launcher was invoked under an issued one-use authorization. That is the accepted cost of counting attempts at invocation rather than at provider creation.
does_not_authorize: a second launch under THIS grant
a replacement pod for this attempt
more than one provider resource for this attempt
a fourth formal attempt, or any attempt beyond the package's three
any retry after formal probe training has started
a retry when it cannot be confirmed whether training started
re-running a valid INCONCLUSIVE in pursuit of a GO
a GPU class other than the accepted secure L40S
using the GPU engineering allowance for complete formal probes or for an endpoint measurement on the frozen confirmation battery
authorizes_nothing_by_itself: this document is an INPUT. It creates no provider resource and permits no execution on its own. A launch additionally requires a launch-bound readiness record swept on the clean pre-authorization tree, an authorization issued from this grant, an exact-session bundle that round-trips, a live quote at or below the accepted rate, and every pre-provider gate passing.

price.rate_is_checked_live: the launcher reads gpuTypes[0].securePrice before creating anything and refuses above --max-price at $0. communityPrice is a different product and has never gated this session.
price.no_fallback_pre_approved: a different GPU class is a repricing and is not authorized here.
